# Ozon Seller API (2.1) — Documentation

> Full API reference for Ozon Seller API version 2.1: 482 endpoints across products, prices, actions, warehouses, FBO/FBS/rFBS postings, chats, reports, analytics and more. Source: official docs.ozon.ru PDF (2026-09-28), converted to Markdown.

Base URL: `https://api-seller.ozon.ru`
Auth headers: `Client-Id` and `Api-Key` (required for all methods).
All request/response bodies are JSON.
